job.title: Maintenance co-ordinator
job.description:
MAINTENANCE COORDINATOR

Step into a key role with one of Australia’s leading drilling contractors. Join a national maintenance team where your trade experience and planning skills will keep a fleet of drill rigs running safely and reliably.

Key Responsibilities
  • Plan, schedule and coordinate preventative, corrective and breakdown maintenance.
  • Liaise with Drilling Operations Managers to set maintenance priorities.
  • Minimise equipment downtime and maximise fleet availability.
  • Provide technical advice and support to field crews during breakdowns.
  • Coordinate internal maintenance teams and external contractors.
  • Prepare quotations, cost estimates and maintenance schedules.
  • Monitor maintenance expenditure and support cost-effective solutions.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and service histories.
  • Provide regular maintenance reports and updates to management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability and processes.
  • Follow and promote all workplace health and safety procedures.
Skills & Experience Required
  • Australian-recognised trade qualification in Heavy Diesel Mechanics, Heavy Plant Fitting or a related mechanical trade.
  • Strong knowledge of heavy diesel equipment, hydraulics, electrical components and air compressors.
  • Experience in maintenance planning and coordination within heavy equipment, mining or drilling.
  • Ability to diagnose equipment issues and coordinate effective repairs.
  • Sound computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and maintenance management systems.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to manage priorities across multiple sites.
  • Experience with tracked drill rigs and exploration drilling equipment, particularly Sandvik, highly regarded.
  • HR licence (or higher) and forklift licence desirable.
ABOUT THE COMPANY
Our client is one of Australia’s leading mineral drilling contractors, servicing the mining and exploration sectors nationwide. Boasting one of the country’s largest and most modern drill fleets and have built their name on safety, technology and reliable service to major miners and junior explorers alike.

job.title: Steel Fixer
job.description:
Precast Steel Fixer
 
We are seeking an experienced Precast Steel Fixer to join a busy precast concrete manufacturing team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and assembling reinforcing steel for precast concrete products, ensuring all work is completed accurately and in line with engineering specifications, quality standards, and workplace safety requirements.
 
BENEFITS
  • Above-award pay rates
  • Genuine long-term career progression opportunities
  • Family-friendly and supportive team environment
  • Monthly team BBQs and workplace events
  • Stable employment with a long-standing Australian family-owned business
 
RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings and production specifications
  • Cut, bend, assemble, and tie reinforcing steel bars and mesh
  • Build reinforcement cages and position steel within moulds before concrete pours
  • Ensure reinforcement is installed correctly to meet structural and quality requirements
  • Perform routine quality checks and inspections
  • Maintain a clean, organised, and safe work environment
  • Operate in accordance with workplace health and safety procedures at all times
 
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
  • Previous experience in steel fixing within precast concrete, manufacturing, or construction environments
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and engineering drawings
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work
  • Physically fit with the ability to perform manual handling tasks
  • Sound understanding of workplace health and safety practices
 
ABOUT THE COMPANY
 
For over two decades they have been leaders in the design, installation and maintenance of stormwater treatment assets and infrastructure.

job.title: Picker Packer
job.description:
PICKER PACKER

The successful candidates will be responsible for accurately picking, packing and preparing food products for dispatch while maintaining high standards of productivity, food safety and workplace hygiene.
 
This is a physically demanding role requiring individuals who are comfortable working in cold temperatures, performing repetitive tasks and working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Pick and pack food products accurately according to customer orders.
  • Work across chilled and frozen storage areas as required.
  • Manual picking lists or warehouse systems to process orders.
  • Check product quantities, labels, expiry dates and product quality.
  • Prepare, label and stage completed orders for dispatch.
  • Assist with stock replenishment, rotation and general warehouse duties.
  • Maintain food safety, hygiene and cold-chain requirements.
  • Perform manual handling, including lifting, bending, reaching and repetitive movements.
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe working environment.
  • Meet daily picking targets and productivity expectations.
  • Follow all workplace health and safety procedures.
Skills & Experience Required
  • Previous pick packing or warehouse experience, preferably within food distribution or cold storage.
  • Experience working in refrigerated or freezer environments highly regarded.
  • Ability and willingness to work in cold conditions for extended periods.
  • Good attention to detail and accuracy when picking orders.
  • Physically capable of performing repetitive manual handling tasks.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Reliable attendance, punctuality and a strong work ethic.
  • Ability to follow instructions and work effectively within a team.
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene practices desirable.
Working Environment & Physical Requirements
  • Regular exposure to refrigerated and freezer temperatures.
  • Prolonged standing, walking and repetitive movements.
  • Manual handling of cartons and food products within safe lifting limits.
  • Wearing appropriate cold-storage PPE, including thermal clothing, gloves and safety footwear.
  • Adherence to strict food safety, hygiene and workplace safety standards.
